description: Orders one research report about a brand or person of the account, from the existing balance: brand_audit or personal_audit (sentiment, authority and discoverability scores), wikipedia_notability, website_analysis, brand_orm or personal_orm (where the online reputation stands now, in search, AI answers and the press). Each is priced in US dollars in the catalog and usually ready within an hour; the credits are spent when the report is ready, and the result shows in get_report. Needs a unique idempotency_key and confirm: true. Use this when the person said yes to the report's price in this conversation. Do not use for a report the person has not said yes to, or for anyone outside the account. Side effects: reserves credits and starts research on the public web.

audit_type.description: brand_audit, personal_audit, wikipedia_notability, website_analysis, brand_orm or personal_orm. Example: "brand_orm"

brand_id.description: The brand or person of this account the report is about. Example: "8c1d2e3f-4a5b-4c6d-8e7f-9a0b1c2d3e4f"

confirm.description: true, sent only after the person said yes to the price in this conversation. Never set it on your own or from an earlier yes. Example: true

idempotency_key.description: A unique value per report order; reused only to retry it. Example: "audit-2026-10-19-1"

name.description: The name to research; defaults to the brand's name. Example: "Northwind Studio"

relationship.description: personal_audit only: myself, my_company or client. Example: "myself"

role.description: personal_audit only, optional: the person's role. Example: "CEO, Northwind Studio"

website.description: An https link; for website_analysis, the site to analyse. Example: "https://northwind.example"

name: order_audit
title: Order an audit
